{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"

# Filter for converted = 1 and status = 'completed'
converted_completed = df[(df['converted'] == 1) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Exclude rows where customer_age == -1 (missing age sentinel)
valid_ages = converted_completed[converted_completed['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute the mean age
mean_age = valid_ages['customer_age'].mean()
